$comment: Audit gate allowlist — consumed by scripts/quality/audit-gate.mjs (pnpm quality:audit, CI job 'Audit Dependencies'). An advisory passes ONLY if it matches both `ghsa` and `package` here AND `expires` has not passed. Never add an entry while a patched version exists upstream — check `npm view <package> dist-tags.latest` first. Expired entries fail the build on purpose. Intentionally EMPTY since 2026-10-17 (#244): the last exemption was deleted together with the unused `@fullhuman/postcss-purgecss` devDependency, which was the only path pulling the affected package into the dependency tree — the gate now runs at zero exemptions again.
